title: 電気回路Ⅰ（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Electric Circuit I
educationalGoal:
(1) Learn the foundations of electronics.
(2) Understand the basic concepts of electric circuits.
(3) Acquire the capability to formulate and analyze various phenomena in electric circuits mathematically.
advice:
This is a basic course on electric circuits. We will mainly cover the following topics:
1. Basic concepts of electric circuits
2. Expressing relationships between voltages and currents in DC circuits in mathematical formulas and calculating voltage, current, and electric power in such circuits
3. Expressing transient phenomena in electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors in differential equations

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are required to be aware of the instructor’s messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
books: Textbooks: Masao Saito, Introduction to Electric Circuits and Systems, Corona Publishing Co., Ltd., 2006 (in Japanese).
requiredKnowledge:
Sufficient skill in mathematical calculations (especially polynomial and fractional expressions).
Basic knowledge of differential calculus.

activityGoals.body: Explain the relationships among voltage, current, and electric power.
Mathematically express the relationships among voltage, current, and electric power in DC circuits.
Express transient phenomena in differential equations.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Express and explain relationships among voltage, current, and electric power in resistors in mathematical formulas.
(2) Use mathematical formulas to express relationships between voltage and current in DC circuits and calculate voltage, current, and electric power.
(3) Use differential equations to express transient phenomena in electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Calculate the voltage, current, and electric power in resistors in relatively simple electric circuits.
(2) Use mathematical formulas to express relationships between voltage and current in relatively simple electric circuits and calculate voltage, current, and electric power.
(3) Use differential equations to express transient phenomena in relatively simple electric circuits consisting of DC power supplies, resistors, capacitors, and inductors.
